messages:
sam: Quick heads-up — I opened a small hotfix PR for the KV cache backoff logic that's been linked to a few p99 latency spikes in prod. Can someone take a quick look? :eyes:

sam: PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/inference/pull/4721 — tiny change but affects retry timing for the request fanout that exposed the spike. Need a couple approvals and a canary run before promote.

alice: grabbing eyes now. Do you have the repro logs or a short description of the spike window?

sam: repro window: 2026-11-03 03:12 UTC. Symptoms: cascade of 429s, increased retries, p99 tokenization latency jump. Canary eu-west showed higher tail latencies but no 429s. Logs snippet attached to PR.

sam: diff is basically one change to backoff calc — posted inline here:
```
- backoff = min(max_backoff, base * attempts)
+ backoff = min(max_backoff, base * math.exp(attempts * 0.1))
```

leo: quick q — switching to exp growth will change early retry spacing. Do we have a unit test that asserts monotonic growth and bounds?

sam: pushing a small unit test in a sec. Test checks monotonic increase and that backoff<=max_backoff.

pri ya: if it's just tweak to shape, i'm fine but would like an e2e traffic replay on canary for 20-30m after merge. I can run it once merged.

alice: I'll review the test and the PR description. If tests + CI pass, i'm inclined to +1. Please add a note in PR description about the rollback plan and canary thresholds.

sam: added test and rollback plan: rollback to previous main if p99 > 1.8s or error rate delta > 0.5% during canary.

deploy-bot: CI queued for hotfix/kv-backoff — running unit + integration suites.

leo: looked through code, left one nit about docstring formatting. behavior looks safe. :thumbsup:

alice: LGTM with nit addressed. Adding +1.

pri ya: ready to run replay after merge. I'll monitor p95/p99, error rate, and traces.

sam: thanks — merging after green CI. tagging for immediate canary window.

deploy-bot: CI passed ✅ — all checks green for hotfix/kv-backoff

deploy-bot: hotfix/kv-backoff merged into main by sam — canary deploy started at 03:47 UTC

pri ya: starting traffic replay now (5qps synthetic) against canary. Dashboard: https://grafana.redwood.ai/d/kv-backoff (watching p95/p99, errorrate, traces).

leo: :eyes: watching traces. If anything odd, i'll open revert PR immediately.

alice: rollback criteria reiterated: p99 > 1800ms OR error rate increase > 0.5%. Priya call it if thresholds breached.

pri ya: 10m into replay — p95 stable, p99 trending down slightly. No error rate spike so far. Will post final after 30m.

sam: huge thanks for the quick reviews and canary run! :raised_hands:

pri ya: 30m update: metrics look good, no anomalous traces. Promoting to prod in the next merge window unless objections.

leo: no objections from me. :shipit:

alice: all good. marking as deployed.

sam: merging/promoting to prod later today per release cadence. Closing loop in the PR. Appreciate the quick turnaround.
